summary: Checks the syntax of the source code of the `4D.Method` object and returns a result object
description:
The .checkSyntax() function checks the syntax of the source code of the 4D.Method object and returns a result object.

The Result object contains the following properties:

success.description: True if no syntax error was detected, false otherwise

errors.description: Available only in case of error or warning. Collection of objects describing errors or warnings

errorModel.note: failure is reported in the returned status object, not by throwing
